about: Code points the exec channel's server-text scrub removes, as inclusive hex ranges over 0..10FFFF. 'dropped' are removed everywhere: Cc, Cf, Cs, Default_Ignorable_Code_Point, U+2028, U+2029, U+2800, U+1D159 and the format characters newer Unicode data adds (U+0890, U+0891, U+13439-U+1343F). 'token_run' (Zs, the space separators) are removed only where they split a secret token. Generated from Node 22 (Unicode 17) and checked against Python Unicode 13 to 16; both clients check their own predicate against this file.
